description: Source code for mod_auth_api, implementing HTTP authentication backend registration and related functions for the lighttpd server.

methods.name: http_auth_scheme_get
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication scheme by name from the static array.

methods.name: http_auth_scheme_set
methods.description: Sets or adds an authentication scheme into the static array.

methods.name: http_auth_backend_get
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication backend by name from the static array.

methods.name: http_auth_backend_set
methods.description: Sets or adds an authentication backend into the static array.

methods.name: http_auth_dumbdata_reset
methods.description: Resets the authentication schemes and backends arrays to zero.

methods.name: http_auth_require_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: http_auth_require_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an http_auth_require_t structure.

methods.name: http_auth_array_contains
methods.description: Checks if a given array contains a specific string token.

methods.name: http_auth_match_rules
methods.description: Checks if user, group, or host matches the authentication requirements.

methods.name: http_auth_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables for remote user and auth type in the request.

methods.name: http_auth_digest_len
methods.description: Returns the length of the digest based on the algorithm used.
